dataset.name: BBBC008
dataset.microscopy: Real fluorescence microscopy acquired on a Cellomics ArrayScan

samples.exclusion_policy: Do not silently exclude. Missing pairs, unreadable files, or dimension mismatches are recorded as failures and reduce the evaluated count.

ground_truth.target: Pixelwise union of official channel 1 and channel 3 binary foreground masks
ground_truth.annotation_method: Automated threshold estimate subsequently cleaned by hand, as documented by BBBC

metrics.aggregate: Macro mean across successfully evaluated fields; p95 and total runtime also reported
metrics.empty_mask_policy: If both prediction and truth are empty, Dice and IoU are 1; otherwise denominators are guarded and failures are recorded.

failure_handling: Every failure is retained with sample ID and exception type. Aggregate denominator is explicit.
generalization_experiment_policy: Frozen v2 results are written first and never overwritten. Any optional preprocessing result is separately labeled and cannot change production configuration.
